channel.title: Lemmy Cafe - mealtimevideos
channel.description:
Not too short, not too long. Videos to last through your meal.

Rules:

  • Submissions must link directly to a video between 5 minutes and 1 hour long.
  • Use a duration in your title such as [9:27].
  • Be mindful that some people will be watching this while eating. No ‘gross’ content, no NSFL, racism, bigotry, etc.
  • Use a title that is descriptive of the actual video.
  • Be respectful of other submitters and commenters. Personal attacks, hate speech, bigotry, etc will not be tolerated.

item.title: [meta] Would you like to have an automated playlist with the most recent videos from this community?
item.description:
submitted by new_otters_raft to mealtimevideos
10 points | 4 comments

I’m still working out the bugs, but this is something I wanted for myself. It would let you add the playlist to your app/account, and also let you automatically play the next video.

I’m thinking of the following:

  • rolling window of around 50 videos, where older videos get dropped
  • a post is only added to the playlist if it has been up for 24 hours, so that spam posts can be removed by mods before getting on to the playlist

item.title: Scott Carney: A reply to the Morning Brew video on generic drugs and how it could be propaganda [11:35]
item.description:
submitted by somereaduser to mealtimevideos
9 points | 3 comments
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H8YdOF1yXfM&pp=ygUMc2NvdHQgY2FybmV5

I saw this video linked here and it didn’t sit right with me; I couldn’t point out why though.

He raises some interesting points to keep in the back of your mind. How the complaints against generic manufcaturers, the FDA has also had against big pharma.

He also raises the point of how a netflix actress (I didn’t know that it was her) and 6 other people made a video with no sponsors. The video is not going to recoup enough to justify its cost, so how is the gap being plugged?

There are a few more interseting points in there.
